notes: Geographic coverage is complete from Interchange 172 to Interchange 0. The study is a selected-path atlas, not an exhaustive inventory of every ramp, local slip, permitted movement or service-area road.
All 310 prior records, 310 branch contexts and 71 group contexts are unchanged. 49 complete source features are appended across 13 southern access groups.
Group 12 describes the entrance-only US 9 access north of Crest Haven; no Exit 12 off-ramp is invented. Entry groups 30, 29, 20, 17 and 6 retain their source-specific partial connections.
All 49 new selections use complete source features. Four inherited selections remain explicitly indexed US 9 excerpts. Existing unique selection keys and source FIDs remain intact.

A few Cape May source lines have very few original points. Their shapes are not smoothed to invent missing curvature; source sparsity is flagged and local-radius statistics should be treated cautiously.
Only source context is clipped at view boundaries. Complete mainlines are now supplied for the overview to both termini; no source arrays or group context are rescaled, rotated or edited in the data.
The terminal group highlights two real source ramps. The continuation into NJ 109 is surrounding road context rather than a made-up extra ramp.
Coordinate verification is not a current-condition, pavement-width, sign, permitted-turn or elevation survey.

sources.title: NJDOT GIS data — New Jersey Roadway Network
supports: NJDOT publishes the Roadway Network as New Jersey’s official linear referencing system.
The public download is labeled last updated August 2025.
Its coverage includes toll roads and ramps.
caveats: This page supplies a month, not the exact publication day. Exact day was separately verified inside the archive.

sources.title: NJDOT Roadway Network, August 2025 — source shapefile and metadata
supports: The bundled metadata explicitly gives the publication date as 2025-08-21.
The source CRS is NAD83 / New Jersey, EPSG:3424, in US survey feet.
This is a public-road centerline inventory, excluding private roads.
The original digitization used 2002 orthophotography and visible road centers; the dataset has subsequent inventory revisions.
Metadata distinguishes generalized road names and directions from the source geometry.
The metadata identifies the dataset as public domain.
caveats: Publication date does not mean every road was surveyed or updated on that date.
Coordinate precision and tiny endpoint gaps do not establish survey accuracy. Original digitization tolerance is described as about 3 feet.
Centerline strokes cannot substantiate lane widths, lane counts, pavement edges, grade separation, current turn permissions, traffic speeds, or construction status.
Metadata contains a content time range ending 2023-05-01 despite the 2025 release; this is another reason not to claim a 2025 pavement survey.

sources.title: Garden State Parkway straight line diagrams — NJDOT
supports: PDF pages 56–62 show the relevant northern corridor, interchange positions, and named crossing roads.
These pages identify Garden State Parkway with SRI 00000444__.
Cross-road labels include Hazel Street, East Ridgewood Avenue, Linwood Avenue, Washington Avenue, Glen Road, and Grand Avenue.
caveats: The retrieved PDF pages say created March 2019 and last inventoried August 2014.
The older document uses generic 155 and 165 labels. It cannot establish present-day signed suffixes.
Exit number and physical milepost are distinct; use source measures, never exit labels, as distances.

sources.title: NJ Turnpike Authority — Parkway toll-calculator road references
supports: The Parkway entrance list names Grand Avenue at 172; Glen Road from Chestnut Ridge Road at 171; Washington Avenue at 168; Pascack Road / Linwood Avenue at 166; Ridgewood Avenue at 165.
It references NJ 17 at 163; NJ 4 west at entrance 161; Paramus Road from NJ 208 at 160; I-80 east/west at 159; Pehle Avenue at 159A.
Its list also references US 46 at 154 and 157 and Lakeview Avenue / NJ 20 south / US 46 at 156.
caveats: These are entrance selector labels, not a complete direction-specific exit or turn-permission table.
An entrance origin must not be substituted for an exit destination. In particular, entry 161 from NJ 4 west does not contradict the NB exit to NJ 4 east.
The list still says 155P for Hazel Street and generic 165. It does not independently substantiate modern 155A/155B and 165A/165B signed labels.

sources.title: East Coast Roads — Parkway northbound, Passaic County
supports: March 2020 photographs and accompanying captions identify 155A with NJ 19 and 155B with Passaic via Hazel Street.

caveats: Photography is dated March 2020. It documents signs then, not an October 2026 field inspection.
Photographs were consulted as evidence; do not reproduce them or imply licensing has been acquired.

prior_provenance.ramp_geometry: Exact source_xy arrays embedded in the user supplied HTML, copied unchanged.
prior_provenance.context_geometry: Direct geometry from the independently downloaded official NJDOT NJ_Roads_shp.zip. Original source vertices are unchanged. Context is clipped at view boundaries by straight-segment intersection; new clipping boundary coordinates are explicitly indexed. No SVG inversion remains in displayed context.
prior_provenance.deduplication: Each official source feature appears once per view; no coordinate deduplication, snapping, fitting, smoothing, rotation, mirroring or resampling.
prior_provenance.ramp_source_verification: All 44 FIDs and SRIs match official download, with all 1,845 source XY vertices exactly equal. pyshp and a separate standard-library SHP/SHX binary reader independently confirm every coordinate.
prior_provenance.context_roles: mainline identifies SRI 00000444__ or 00000444_S; connector identifies other GSP-attributed features or roads named in selected source endpoint evidence; local identifies other contextual road features. Role styling is not lane count, pavement width or route importance.

wgs84_transform.operation: Inverse of SPCS83 New Jersey zone (US survey foot) + NAD83 to WGS 84 (1) (with axis order normalized for visualization)
wgs84_transform.note: A coordinate-operation accuracy value is not the positional/survey accuracy of the roadway source. Exact projected coordinates remain the audit source.
